summary: Iteration 15 verification of 6 new enhancements on preview URL (mobile 390x844, Grace auto-auth). Backend GET /api/v1/activity/water-trend returns 200 with 7 points {date,label,waterMl} + goalMl=2000 (verified via curl). Frontend results: (1) Calorie card icon ✓ - amber/orange circular container with Flame lucide-react SVG present in [data-testid=metric-card-calories]. (2) Active Workout Progress Ring ✓ structure - SVG with linearGradient #28d9f3 → #c5b8ff wraps timer, background+foreground circles present, transition: stroke-dashoffset 1s linear; timer counts down correctly and freezes on pause (t3=19:56, t4=19:56 across 2s paused). BUT stroke-dashoffset does NOT visibly change over 3-5 real seconds for a 20-min workout because percentComplete uses Math.round((elapsed/totalSeconds)*100) which stays at 0 until ≥6s have elapsed (0.5% of 1200s). Minor UX bug — remove Math.round or increase precision so users see the ring animate on short observations. (3) Custom Reminder Times ✓ FULL PASS - clicking pencil edit button (data-testid=reminder-time-edit-{id}) reveals inline <input type='time'> (data-testid=reminder-time-input-{id}); changing to 09:15 and blurring persists to localStorage vitality_reminder_times={"6a9b40eff49f7846cb99862a":"09:15"}; after hard reload the button re-displays '09:15' instead of seed '08:00'. (4) Podcast Resume Playback — MIXED. Audio play works (SoundHelix mp3, ct advances). localStorage vitality_podcast_progress persists as {trackId: seconds} (verified 3.86s saved). RESUME on reload works: after refresh, hitting play on same track, audio.currentTime jumps to ~5.3s (started from saved ~3.86 and advanced). HOWEVER two functional gaps: (a) Second click on the SAME track (both daily-pick and list card) does NOT pause — audio.paused stays false; the button/card only starts audio, never toggles. (b) The progress bar [data-testid=podcast-progress-{trackId}] never renders in practice for typical short interactions because it is gated by `listenedPercent > 0` where listenedPercent = Math.round((seconds / (durationMinutes*60)) * 100); a 15-minute episode requires ≥4.5s listened before the bar becomes visible, and even that only rounds up if ≥ 4.5s. Additionally, the daily-pick track ID (6a9b40eff49f7846cb99861e) is NOT among the 4 track cards in the trackList (…861f, …8620, …8621, …8622), so playing the daily pick can never surface a progress bar anywhere in the UI. (5) Hydration 7-Day Trend Chart ✓ - LogWaterModal renders WaterTrendChart with data-testid=log-water-trend-chart / log-water-trend-svg; 7 rounded bars, 1 dashed goal reference line ([stroke-dasharray] present), day labels Sat/Sun/Mon/Tue/Wed/Thu/Fri rendered as divs beneath the SVG (not <text> inside SVG — see minor note). All 7 seeded data points (1200–1450 ml) are below the 2000 ml goal so all bars use the lighter/lavender fill uniformly; cannot visually confirm the darker/filled variant for above-goal days from current seed. (6) Workout Summary Modal — CRITICAL BUG: clicking [data-testid=todays-workout-item-0] via a normal user-style Playwright click does NOT open the modal. Root cause: the today's-workout list item renders a <button> with a nested <button data-testid=todays-workout-delete-*> inside it (invalid HTML). React logs 'validateDOMNesting: <button> cannot appear as a descendant of <button>' on every render, and the browser hoists/splits the inner button out of the outer, breaking the outer button's onClick delegation for many click positions. When bypassed via element.click() the modal opens correctly and shows 20 MINUTES / 250 KCAL / Zone 4–5 High Intensity, plus Warm-up 4min + Main Set 12min + Cool-down 4min (sums to 20 = total activeMinutes). Fix: convert outer <button> to <div role='button' tabIndex={0}> (with onKeyDown for Enter/Space) or move delete outside the item card.

ui_bugs.issue: Nested <button> inside <button> (todays-workout-item wraps todays-workout-delete). Invalid DOM causes React validateDOMNesting warning and prevents the outer item click from opening WorkoutSummaryModal in real user interactions.
Second click on a playing track does not toggle to pause; audio.paused remains false. handleTrackClick only starts playback and does not pause the current track when re-clicked.

podcast-progress-{trackId} bar is gated by Math.round((seconds/(minutes*60))*100) > 0, so bar does not appear until >=~4.5s listened on a 15-min episode. Additionally the daily-pick track is not represented in the trackList, so its progress bar has no place to render even though its progress is saved to localStorage.
strokeDashoffset uses Math.round(percent) so for a 20-min workout no visible ring change occurs in the first ~6 seconds. Request explicitly asked to verify ring fill increases over ~3-5s.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking todays-workout-item-0 via Playwright click() at real coordinates does not fire outer onClick; JS-driven .click() works and shows correct content. Real users on some devices may see similar swallowed clicks.

issues: Onboarding tooltip 'Log your meals — Track breakfast before 9am / GOT IT' overlaps the first podcast card in the Wellness grid — same complaint noted in iteration_14. Consider suppressing onboarding tooltips on non-primary screens.

Day labels are rendered as HTML div text beneath the SVG (not as <text> nodes inside log-water-trend-svg). Functional but readers of the SVG alone (e.g. screenshot exports) will lack labels. Consider embedding <text> inside SVG for accessibility.

action_items: Fix nested <button> in ActivityTracker (line 165-198): change outer todays-workout-item element from <button> to <div role='button' tabIndex={0} onKeyDown={enterHandler}> OR keep <button> and move the delete trash outside the card. This unblocks the summary modal open-on-tap.
Fix podcast play/pause toggle: handleTrackClick should call audio.pause() (via context) when clicked on the currently-playing track instead of only starting playback.

Fix podcast progress bar visibility: change `listenedPercent > 0` gate to render bar whenever `listenedSeconds > 0` (or use Math.max(0.5, ...) width). Also decide whether the daily-pick card should show its own progress bar (currently no bar exists there).
Optional polish: remove Math.round in ActiveWorkoutModal's percentComplete so the progress ring animates smoothly from t=0.
critical_code_review_comments: Invalid HTML in ActivityTracker.tsx (button-in-button) — high priority; produces continuous React warnings in dev and unreliable click behavior in prod.
AudioPlayerContext / MindfulnessPodcast play/pause semantics are incomplete: clicking currently-playing track should toggle pause, not restart.
listenedPercent uses Math.round which hides small progress values; consider ceil or a minimum floor width so the persisted-progress UX is visible.
Daily-pick podcast should also expose a data-testid=podcast-progress-{id} element so persisted progress is visually indicated on the hero card, not just the grid card.
WaterTrendChart labels: prefer <text> nodes inside the SVG for accessibility and SVG-only export fidelity.
Prior iteration_14 note still valid: onboarding tooltip overlaps content on modal/detail screens (LogWaterModal, Podcast list).

success_rate.frontend: 3/6 fully pass (calorie icon, reminder times, water trend chart). 3/6 have functional bugs (progress ring rounding, podcast play/pause+progress-bar, workout summary tap-to-open blocked by button-in-button).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend water-trend endpoint fine. The 3 confirmed frontend fixes needed: (a) unnest delete button inside today's-workout list-item button in /app/frontend/src/features/activity/ActivityTracker.tsx (lines 165 & 186), (b) make podcast track re-click pause current audio in MindfulnessPodcast.tsx + AudioPlayerContext, (c) lower the visibility threshold for podcast-progress bar (drop Math.round or change > 0 to > 0 seconds). After fixes, re-run the podcast play→pause→bar-visible→reload→resume flow and the Activity → tap workout → summary modal flow.
rca of the issue: 1) Workout summary tap-to-open: Chromium's HTML parser splits nested <button> into siblings at parse time; React's virtual DOM keeps them nested causing hydration mismatch and click bubbling anomalies. Correct fix is to change outer element to a non-<button> interactive (div role=button) so the inner delete <button> is legal. 2) Podcast pause: MindfulnessPodcast's handleTrackClick likely calls play(track) unconditionally without checking currentTrack.id===track.id && isPlaying. 3) Progress bar hidden: listenedPercent = Math.round((seconds/(minutes*60))*100) collapses to 0 for small elapsed times; guard is `listenedPercent > 0`, so nothing renders. 4) Ring animation: same rounding pattern in ActiveWorkoutModal (Math.round on 100 * elapsed/totalSeconds) delays first visible movement of stroke-dashoffset until ~1% of duration elapses (~12s for 20 minutes).
